# Ultra-Fast Proxy Fetcher and Tester 2.0.2

This release tightens input, feed decompression, archive, and output handling. Release promotion verifies canonical distribution bytes. The package description and exact installation example match the release, and the package requires Python 3.12 through 3.14.

Use the utility only in authorized testing. Public proxies are untrusted. A connectivity result does not establish that an endpoint can safely carry sensitive traffic.
